title: A DC Composite Optimization via Variable Smoothing for Robust Phase Retrieval with Nonconvex Loss Functions
summary: In this paper, we propose an optimization-based method for robust phase retrieval problem where the goal is to estimate an unknown signal from a quadratic measurement corrupted by outliers. To enhance the robustness of existing optimization models with the $\ell_1$ loss function, we propose a generalized model that can handle DC (Difference-of-Convex) loss functions beyond the $\ell_1$ loss. We view the cost function of the proposed model as a composition of a DC function with a smooth mapping, and develop a variable smoothing algorithm for minimizing such DC composite functions.
